title: The Judgment on Israel's Pride
description: The Lord sends a word of judgment against Jacob and Israel because the people, in pride and arrogance, believe they can rebuild what has fallen with even better materials. God raises up enemies against them from east and west, cutting off both head and tail—leaders and false prophets who lead the people astray—and lets evil burn like fire throughout the land. Finally, brothers turn against one another: Manasseh against Ephraim and Ephraim against Manasseh, and together they turn against Judah, while the Lord's anger has not yet turned away and his hand is still stretched out.
